description.main: Photographs David Bailey made in New York in January 1962 on his first foreign assignment for Vogue, travelling with the model Jean Shrimpton. Steidl, 2007.
description.extended:
Photographs made in New York in January 1962 by David Bailey, then in his early twenties, on his first trip abroad for Vogue with the model Jean Shrimpton.

Bailey went to the United States, the home of the jazz he admired. He carried a recently acquired 35mm camera and shot quickly on the streets, outside the studio for the first time. The trip came before he met Andy Warhol and a year before the Rolling Stones arrived in America. The book is clothbound at 66 pages, with 24 tritone and 3 color plates.

Bailey served in the Royal Air Force in Singapore before this trip. His other Steidl books include Delhi Dilemma (2010), Bailey's East End (2014) and Tears and Tears (2016).

notes: EDITION AMBIGUITY: two Steidl 2007 ISBNs exist. 9783865214140 = English first edition (April 2007; D.A.P. 66 pp, clothbound, black cloth with white lettering). 9783865214416 = a second Steidl issue (OpenLibrary Mar 2007; black cover with embossed lettering; one source called it the French edition, unverified in saved sources). Spine alone does not settle it; lead should check the physical copy against the cover images (cover saved is 140 edition). Page count: D.A.P. 66, OpenLibrary 64. Description claim "title as a bare code: New York, Jean Shrimpton, David Bailey, 1962" is an inference from the title letters NY JS DB 62; drop it if the lead wants only sourced claims. davidbailey.com returned 200 (GoDaddy site, generic title); confirm it is Bailey's own site before ingest.
